## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed or what feature is added. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## How Has This Been Tested?
Please describe the tests that you verified your changes on. 
- [ ] Tested on a singleplayer world
- [ ] Tested on a multiplayer server (with Simple Voice Chat)
- [ ] Checked logs for errors/warnings

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary
